As a production employee at Mola, you work at a steady pace on the production line. Your tasks include
replenishing and checking products, such as blocks of butter or bags of sugar, and ensuring that everything runs
smoothly on the line. Additionally, you contribute to a clean work environment. You don't mind getting your hands
dirty and if there is a malfunction, you take initiative and quickly look for a solution.

Where will you work
Come and work at Mola in Beugen, an innovative industrial bakery that produces the tastiest frozen puff pastry
products. We stand for quality and craftsmanship and deliver our products worldwide.
